notes.title: Nature Escapes 3 - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Nature lovers, rejoice! The highly anticipated return of Nature Escapes is finally here! Immerse yourself in a world of stunning plants and flowers from around the globe. Enjoy a brand new set of beautiful hidden object scenes and listen to relaxing music as you discover fun facts about the plants you encounter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987205/24d3ca9d33d052972c1ea9ff4de24a1699f9de05.gif[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] 24 chapters of nature fun!
[*] Over 70 total HO Scenes and Minigames!
[*] Fun facts about fun plants!
[*] Explore gorgeous, handcrafted nature scenes!
[*] Decorate your very own garden!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987205/23ae5ca3452875d68bc48f3378d90cf2fb31549f.gif[/img]

[h2]The Collector's Edition includes[/h2]
[list]
[*] 6 extra locations
[*] 12 minigames
[*] Downloadable wallpapers
[*] Music player
[*] Additional plants and flowers
[*] Explore the developer's own plant children
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43987205/ac70a3a5fd3617a6ff7712cb1b4c0642046044f9.gif[/img]

Decorate your very own garden scene and make it your own! Download Nature Escapes now and start your journey into the great outdoors!
